canonical_api.output_contract: out_maze is reset to NULL before validation and receives caller ownership only on success

algorithm.initial_grid: open interior with a blocked one-cell perimeter
algorithm.division: each selected even-coordinate wall spans its region and retains exactly one odd-coordinate passage
algorithm.orientation: split the longer eligible axis; equal spans choose with one bounded RNG draw
algorithm.execution: explicit LIFO region stack preserving the corrected depth-first child and RNG order
algorithm.rng: shared Maze PCG32 generation context with bounded draws
algorithm.topology: connected and acyclic by induction: each split joins two child trees through exactly one passage

validation.dimensions: width and height are odd and at least 3
validation.bounds: the inclusive last coordinate and each dimension must fit int32_t
validation.max_steps: one step per active region split; default is raster cells times 4
validation.cancellation: polled before generation, throughout raster materialization, and for every active or terminal region
validation.exception_barrier: bad_alloc maps to OUT_OF_MEMORY; callback exceptions map to CALLBACK_FAILED; other exceptions map to CORRUPT_STATE
validation.failure_atomicity: partial Maze output is never published

compatibility.legacy_policy: deprecated ABI 1.x adapter forwarding to the checked generator
compatibility.generic_dispatcher: BYUL_MAZE_ALGORITHM_RECURSIVE_DIVISION produces the same raster for equal options
